approved_default_policy.missing_roots: !C, !area, !G_MAIN, missing/foreign raw CTX_wm_manager relative to G_MAIN->wm => false. No provider-sensitive context getter is called.
approved_default_policy.membership: After current manager membership, scan every manager/window modalhandlers list from current G_MAIN. Compare actual OP handler context.area to opaque target address; never dereference target or saved context area/window/region. Foreign C.window does not censor any actual window.
approved_default_policy.inactive_no_owner: No relevant OP => true, including inactive/non-active-screen target and current manager with no windows. Active-screen membership is not required for proving global absence.
approved_default_policy.registered_native_node: Actual currently registered NODE_OT_link type identity => false, including mismatched current profile; another registered type with the exact native callback profile also refuses conservatively.
approved_default_policy.known_other_types: Registered other type may pass only under this bounded identity/profile policy. This does not prove arbitrary custom callbacks cannot invoke Node semantics.
approved_default_policy.unknown: Relevant null op/type, unregistered type, inconsistent nonmacro runtime fields or malformed/unknown active macro => false.
approved_default_policy.macro: Registered macro root must have opm and nonempty first/last runtime list. Walk actual macro list with prev-link and final-last consistency, compare child addresses before inspecting active child. Matched active child must differ from root, point opm back to root, have no runtime macro, and have current registered nonmacro type. Actual Node/profile clone refuses; known unrelated child passes.
approved_default_policy.pending_removal: DO_FREE does not establish absence: still-listed relevant handler is inspected normally and blocks until actual removal.
approved_default_policy.ids: No ID/session UID/type-lifetime/operator-lifetime or positive owner/contact/drag ID is read or allocated. Zero values do not alter this instantaneous query.
approved_default_policy.no_side_effects: No poll, invoke, modal, Cancel, provider, UI/report callback, context setter, graph/tree/customdata read, handler mutation, token/lifetime allocation, free or event synthesis.
approved_default_policy.non_apple: All additions and root consumer are guarded; native nonApple source behavior remains.

registry_boundary.claim: Nonallocating in supported ordinary initialized UI operator-registry corridor. Registry access is delayed until relevant nonnull OP with nonnull type. No relevant OP does not touch registry.
registry_boundary.source: wm_operator_type.cc get_operators_map54-68 lazily reserve(2048); WM_operatortypes_registered_get70-73; WM_operatortype_find78-101 uses local char buffer and quiet lookup; wm_operatortype_append__end121-145 adds registered types via same map. Actual registered native Node modal necessarily follows this registration.
registry_boundary.excluded: No global guarantee for malformed externally fabricated pre-registry modalhandlers or arbitrary first-ever map initialization. Registry and intrusive lists retain ordinary native UI-thread validity assumptions; arbitrary corrupted-pointer/cyclic-list safety is not claimed.
